# Silicon Lawsets
## Job Lawsets
Lawsets written around a specific job or role, rather than the crew as a whole. Each one has a law board printed at that department's fabricator - or at the science circuit imprinter, for departments without one - and can be slotted into a cyborg's law socket or uploaded to the station AI.
## General Lawsets
The classics, plus everything a silicon might end up running after an ion storm.
